risk_note: RV2 by path (contracts / generated routes, packages/domain state machine; agent store, http, stream mount, application). 规划 11-12 A3: setAgentMessageFeedback and reportAgentMessage drop x-implementation: planned (generated planned-operations / route-schemas regenerated) and are registered in controller.ts through the same caller resolution as the other agent routes. User data ownership (BR-AI-20): only an assistant message of the caller's own session (member by user_id; guest by device_id with user_id and user_hash null; a token never falls back to the device); not found, not yours, a user-role message and a purged session all answer 30504 without data, identically. Writes (agent is the single writer of these agent_messages columns): feedback / feedback_at, down sets badcase (up does not clear it, 08 open); a first report sets reported, report_reason, reported_at and report_status pending through the generated transitionAgentReport(null,'REPORT') under SELECT … FOR UPDATE; a repeated report keeps the first one (idempotent 200, 08 open, stated in the PR); agent_sessions (last_active_at) and agent_runs are not touched. Admin port for B1-10t: handleAgentReport(trx, clock, input) in agent/application/agent-report.ts, wrapped by createAgentReportAdminPort; one conditional UPDATE (app_id, id, role assistant, report_status pending, row_version = expected) in the caller's transaction with the state from transitionAgentReport('pending','HANDLE'); the union result (handled / not_found / not_reported / already_handled / cas_conflict) is read afterwards, never thrown. State machine specs/state-machines/agent-report.yaml (states pending / handled; events REPORT / HANDLE, technical names — the generator requires UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, D10-1472). Frozen [AC-CT-08e#1] in test/spec/contracts/agent-history/http.test.ts: only its planned assertion flipped (D10-1385 / D10-1455); the 7 unchanged tests of that file are red_exempt (ledger, PR #26).
